summary: Vote-change feature (max 2 changes) + dynamic nickname colouring via nickname_side tested end-to-end. Backend: 2/2 pytest cases PASS (test_vote_changes.py). Frontend: all 7 UI assertions PASS at 390x844 including first vote, same-side reject, A->B switch (hint '1 volta' singular), 2nd switch (hint 'esaurito'), 3rd change no-op, comment stays in PRO A tab with nickname_side=B after vote change, and unvoted-user regression hint still shown.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' still logged repeatedly (pre-existing, non-blocking, react-native-web internal).

backend_assertions.third_change_403: PASS ('Hai raggiunto il limite di 2 cambi voto')
backend_assertions.get_feud_carries_changes_state: PASS (my_vote_changes=2, my_vote_changes_left=0 on GET /feuds/{id} with Bearer)

frontend_assertions.comment_still_visible_in_PRO_A_after_swi: PASS (frozen side); backend nickname_side=B confirmed via /api/feuds/{id}/comments

frontend_assertions.third_change_tap_noop: PASS (my_vote and my_vote_changes unchanged after tapping vote-B when exhausted)

action_items: OPTIONAL: address 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' warnings (pre-existing carry-over, not caused by this feature).
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py POST /feuds/{id}/vote correctly guards MAX_VOTE_CHANGES with same-side 400, third-change 403, and increments change_count only on side switch.
GET /feuds/{id} exposes my_vote_changes and my_vote_changes_left based on the vote row's change_count.
get_comments / list_replies join the live votes collection and embed nickname_side per commenter — falls back to c['side'] when the user later revokes/no vote row exists (defensive).
frontend feud/[id].tsx disables the currently-chosen side always and disables the OTHER side only when my_vote_changes_left<=0. Hint pluralizes correctly (volta vs volte).
CommentItem uses sideColor(c.nickname_side || c.side) so nickname colour updates immediately after the vote() call reloads comments.
seed_data_creation: Signed up two fresh email users (TEST_vc_* and TEST_vcui_*) plus one anonymous user for regression. Cast up to 2 vote changes on live feuds and posted 1 comment marked with TEST_ prefix.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Vote-change feature is fully working across backend (MAX_VOTE_CHANGES=2 enforcement, changed flag, feud.my_vote_changes/_left) and frontend (dynamic hint pluralization, disabled-state logic, comment reload with nickname_side). No regressions observed on standard hint or anonymous flows.
